notes: This minor release raises the engine requirement to Bifrost 0.15.3 or later and depends exactly on bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0. Migration: Bifrost 0.15.2 and earlier reject the whole catalog because the restored Cargo SSH policy declares an empty required_capabilities list ("incomplete inventory metadata"); upgrade the engine or stay on rules 0.15.0. Bifrost 0.15.3 accepts an empty list (bifrost-dev#10941). Every locked policy identity verifies unchanged on the released Bifrost 0.15.3. Restored in bifrost.security 3.2.0 (#387): the opt-in bifrost.security.rust.cargo-ssh-git-host-key-unverified (CVE-2022-46176), held out since rules 0.13.0. It reports a locked git+ssh Cargo dependency in a package whose rust-toolchain file pins a Rust release before 1.66.1. Changed behavior: Bifrost 0.15.3 no longer reports a workspace .cargo/config.toml as unsupported dependency evidence, so the policy reads the workspace-root .cargo/config.toml configuration fact net.git-fetch-with-cli; the boolean true suppresses the finding for a pinned Rust 1.39.0 or later (the first Cargo that reads .cargo/config.toml) unless a .cargo/config.toml in a subdirectory sets it to anything else, where Bifrost 0.15.1 left the run inconclusive. Limitations: only workspace .cargo/config.toml files are read; ambient Cargo configuration, the legacy extensionless .cargo/config, CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI, rustup overrides and git insteadOf rewrites are not, and the extensionless file or the environment variable can make a suppressed project use the built-in fetcher again; an unpinned toolchain or a missing Cargo.lock leaves the run inconclusive. Changed in bifrost.python-codeql-quality 0.1.2 (#383, bifrost-dev#11358): bifrost.python-codeql-quality.missing-docstring no longer reports test code (pytest-collected modules, unittest.TestCase subclasses, test* functions in modules that import pytest or nose) or a function a module's __main__ block calls; it reads the test_scope and entry_point fields that Bifrost 0.15.3 first emits (bifrost-dev#11705), withholds an undecided row rather than reporting it clean, and departs from CodeQL parity on purpose. All other policies, IDs and required capabilities are unchanged from rules 0.15.0. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
